query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 60,
  radar_freshness = 65,
  radar_warmth = 40,
  radar_sweetness = 80,
  radar_spiciness = 20,
  radar_earthiness = 25
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%floral%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%rose%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%jasmin%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%fleur%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
